verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a token revocation endpoint covering both access and refresh tokens. An introspection endpoint lets services check whether a token is still active, which supports enforcing server-side revocation. Admins can manage user sessions, users can manage their own sessions, and single sign-out ends sessions across applications. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable session/token expiry timeouts (idle/max lifespan), detail on refresh-token rotation behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of immediate revocation of a compromised session.
